description: Python source code defining a class IPC_MPV for managing mpv media player via IPC, including methods for controlling playback, retrieving properties, and sending commands through a Unix socket.

classes.name: IPC_MPV
classes.description: Class for managing mpv media player through IPC, providing methods to control playback, adjust settings, and communicate via socket.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes IPC_MPV instance, sets socket path, and starts mpv process.

methods.name: init_mpv
methods.description: Starts the mpv process with specified options and IPC socket.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a JSON command to the mpv IPC server via Unix socket and returns the response data.

methods.name: playlist_next
methods.description: Skips to the next item in the playlist.

methods.name: playlist_prev
methods.description: Returns to the previous item in the playlist.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the media.

methods.name: screenshot_to_file
methods.description: Saves a screenshot of the current video to a file.
